title: Personal output sprint manuscript — living OKR notebook
content:
Context:
This is my running, messy notebook for the next two sprint cycles (14d each). The aim: converge on a sustainable weekly cadence of output while keeping a small set of measurable objectives I actually care about. Treat as scratch — copy out the parts that become stable into a formal OKR doc later.

High-level intention:
- North star: ship reliable small features that reduce unplanned support work and increase demo-ready demos for the team.
- Tempo goal for this cycle: 3 shipped items (PRs merged + deploy to staging until QA signoff) and one repeatable eval harness for perf regressions.

Concrete objectives (draft):
1) Reduce my mean time to merge (MTTM) on personal PRs to <48h.
   - Indicator: avg days between PR open -> merged for last 6 PRs. Baseline: 3.6 days.
   - Quick experiments: pair reviews Monday blocks; tiny PR rule (<=200 LOC); auto-assign reviewer on PR creation via GH action (WIP).
2) Increase reliable demos / week from 0.5 -> 1.5.
   - Indicator: count of demo-able changes (not just fixes) per week.
   - Focus: break larger work into demoable slices; schedule 30-min Friday show-and-tell slot.
3) Make a minimal regression test harness for the evaluation pipeline (perf + correctness smoke).
   - Indicator: one scripted harness that runs in CI and produces a pass/fail metric before merging model changes.

Weekly checklist (proto):
- Monday: plan 3 focus blocks, triage inbox, mark 2 PRs for early review.
- Tue/Wed: deep work (blocks), leave 60m for async reviews.
- Thu: integration + demo prep.
- Fri: ship checklist, run mini-retro, post 1-line status in #team-weekly.

Retrospective notes (running):
- 2026-01-29: Missed demo goal. Root cause: scope creep (one task ballooned to refactor). Action: enforce 25% time-box on refactor items; create scaffold PR that isolates refactor.
- 2026-02-12: MTTM dropped to 1.7 days after pairing experiment. Keep pairing on Mondays, continue small PR rule.
- 2026-02-25: CI flakiness blocked harness rollout. Next actions: add flaky-test tags and quarantine, file ticket JIRA-PERSONAL-19 for flaky test triage.

Micro-experiments (to run this sprint):
- Experiment A: reviewer-rotation for two weeks (assign Amina then Ravi). Hypothesis: rotation reduces reviewer load and speeds merges. Metric: MTTM delta.
- Experiment B: one 30-min Friday demo slot enforced (calendar invite with buffer). Hypothesis: visible demos increase cross-team feedback and reduce rework. Metric: number of demo comments that lead to changes.
- Experiment C: commit message template that forces a short rationale + test notes. Hypothesis: reduces back-and-forth in reviews. Measurement: average number of review rounds per PR.

Open questions / friction points:
- How strict should I be about demo 'completeness'? If I over-slice, I accumulate many tiny artifacts that don't move the product forward. Priority: favor slices that unlock feedback from other teams.
- Time boxing: is 3 focus blocks per day realistic given calendar meetings? Track for two weeks and adjust.
- CI budget: do I spend cycle time stabilizing CI for personal harness (opportunity cost) vs. relying on team SRE? Log time spent and review with SRE during retro.

Snippets to copy into formal OKR doc later:
- Objective: "Ship small, demoable features reliably" with key results: MTTM < 2 days; >= 1.5 demos/week; test harness in CI by end of cycle.

Quick metrics snapshot (manual, update weekly):
- Week starting 2026-02-23:
  - PRs opened: 4
  - PRs merged: 3
  - Mean time to merge: 2.0 days
  - Demo-able changes: 1
  - Focus blocks completed (planned 9): 7

To-dos (this sprint):
- [ ] Add GH action to auto-assign reviewers (repo: redwood/sandbox). Ticket: https://github.com/redwood/sandbox/issues/112
- [ ] Draft CI harness minimal runner script and add to PR template. (link to gist draft in pinned notes)
- [ ] Schedule Friday demo recurring invite for next 6 weeks (30m).
- [ ] Pair review session with Ravi next Monday 10:00–11:30.

Notes-to-self (fragments):
- Keep acceptance criteria tiny and testable. If I can't write 3 tests easily, scope down.
- If blocked >24h on a review, ping in thread and reassign.
- Consider doing a weekly 'stability sweep' to quarantine flaky tests (10m).
- Archive this file into /confluence/personal-okrs when stable.

Relevant links / references:
- Confluence draft: CONFLUENCE-4532 (personal OKR template)
- Small PR rule discussion: slack thread #eng-process (link pinned)
- PR with harness prototype: https://github.com/redwood/sandbox/pull/89

End of scratch — keep lean. If something sticks for 2 weeks, promote to formal doc.
